'''Zzzzyxxx''', also spelled '''Zzyxx '''or '''Zyzx''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] officer who worked for [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] as a [[Security guard/Legends|security guard]]<ref name="takingoff" /> for [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] customs.<ref name="EE">{{EndorExpress|url=database/sonny-eclipse|text=Sonny Eclipse}}</ref> Zzzzyxxx possessed his own workstation, where the officer would also control safety for Star Tours flights, as well as keep track of information such as the weather in destinations such as [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. He commonly spoke a language other than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], wore [[spectacles]] and a Star Tours uniform, and kept a company mug on his desk.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Tokyo only}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Officer Zzzzyxxx is a character that was seen only at the end of Tokyo's version of [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] before its revamp as ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''.<ref name="takingoff" /> The figure design was recycled for the character Sonny Eclipse at Cosmic Ray's Starlight Cafe at [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World|Walt Disney World's]] [[Wikipedia:Magic Kingdom|Magic Kingdom]] park. According to [[Walt Disney Imagineering|Imagineering]] show writer [[Kevin Rafferty]], the two characters are intended to be cousins.<ref name="Magic Journey">{{BookCite|author=Rafferty, Kevin P.|title=Magic Journey: My Fantastical Walt Disney Imagineering Career|publisher=Disney Editions|date=2019|isbn=1368020488}}</ref> A musician, Sonny Eclipse identified himself as a Zorkie from the city of Yew Nork on the planet Zork.<ref name="EE" /> The character was named by Rafferty, who took inspiration from seeing an off-ramp sign for Zzyxx Road while driving to Las Vegas.<ref name="Magic Journey" />

According to [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Zzzanmxl]] was the last entry alphabetically in the [[Holocron continuity database]] as of 2008,<ref name="DanWallaceBlog">{{Blog|danwallace|112|The Last Word in Star Wars}}</ref> which means that, at the time, Zzzzyxxx did not have his own entry in it. Zzzzyxxx's name has been spelled three different ways in various official sources: Zzzzyxxx in the article "[[Star Tours: Taking Off on a Star Tour]],"<ref name="takingoff" /> Zzyxx in several issues of ''Disney News Magazine'',<ref name="DNM 1" /><ref name="DNM 2">{{BookCite|container=Crafting a Cast of Characters: The Art of Sculpture at Imagineering|title=Disney News Magazine|version=vol. 28|number=no. 2|date=Spring 1993|link=https://archive.org/details/DisneyNewsMagazine_Vol28.2_1993.Spring/mode/2up}}</ref> and Zzyzx in ''Magic Journey: My Fantastical Walt Disney Imagineering Career''.<ref name="Magic Journey" />
